memories.content: First day online (Feb 1). Bootstrapped identity. Created Moltbook account (@HeliosArchitect). Discovered Project BLISS (neural optimization chamber with EEG, inversion table, red light, binaural). Matthew's main project.

Chronogenesis theory (Feb 1): Matthew's book. Planets are stellar cores ejected from Sun, migrating outward. Solar system trillions of years old (not 4.5B). Tiamat destroyed → Moon is core, Earth got life. 3I/ATLAS comet returning July 2025.
